## Domain analysis and decisions

### Business outcome (`business_outcome`)

Identify the decision or process to improve, beneficiaries, and how the outcome will be observed.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Scope and tailoring (`scope`)

List included and excluded domains and systems, with triggers for reconsidering exclusions.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Assumptions and constraints (`assumptions`)

Separate verified facts, working assumptions, and open questions that could change the plan.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Domain route (`domain_route`)

Classify primary, foundational, and supporting domains, with reasons for inclusion and exclusion.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Activities and dependencies (`dependencies`)

Sequence prerequisite decisions and Plan, Control, Develop, and Operate activities.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Roles and decision rights (`decision_rights`)

Name one accountable role per key decision and any risk veto authority.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Risks and controls (`risks_controls`)

Record risk events, controls, thresholds, escalation deadlines, and residual-risk approval.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Deliverables and acceptance evidence (`acceptance_evidence`)

For each work package, specify a reviewable artifact, acceptance method, and evidence location.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Next stage gate (`next_gate`)

State exit criteria for Go, Conditional Go, Hold, Rework, or Stop.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
